title: A ledger that explains every refund
summary: Keep money records that are correct, and can answer why a merchant's balance is what it is.
context: Jalebi Pay holds money for merchants between payment and settlement. Refunds, chargebacks and fees all change what a merchant is owed. Balances are now a column updated in several places, and last month it disagreed with the bank by four lakh rupees.
Nobody could say when the difference began. Merchants ask why they were paid less than expected, and support has to read code to answer.
must_handle: Every change in a balance can be traced to the event that caused it.
A balance cannot go wrong by a repeated or retried event.
A partial refund after settlement is handled.
A daily check compares the books with the bank's report.
A wrong entry is corrected by a new entry and never by editing history.
show_in_answer: The tables and the entries for one payment, one refund and one settlement.
How a balance is read fast.
How a retried event is recognised.
How a merchant's question gets answered from this data.
